text:
Roman Josi is 36, a former Norris winner with 1,053 games in a Nashville sweater, and still playing 25:34 a night. He has 23 points in 23 games, 21 of them assists, and the Predators are better with him on the ice at five on five than without him by a wide margin.

The odd part is the goals. He has two on 4.5 expected (expected goals: the quality of his chances), shooting 3.2% on 62 shots, below the 4.7% to 7.8% range our numbers see as his true talent. That's not decline; his chance rate is right where it was last season. Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking said he got to the home-plate area in front of the net more than 84% of defensemen. It's a cold streak, and those tend to end when the looks keep coming. Our numbers project 8 to 18 goals by season's end, and 63 to 88 points. Evolving-Hockey rated him 36th among defensemen last season, with a knack for drawing penalties. If you want one thing to watch, it's whether his shot volume holds while the puck refuses to go in.
headline: Josi is setting up everything except himself
